legend: One day, Dunno came up with a new cube game – he lined up the cubes in a long line from left to right, and then removed pairs of adjacent cubes with a certain property. After removing a couple of cubes, the line on the right shifted to the left by two positions to fill the empty space. Dunno has exactly n$$$n$$$ cubes, and each one is signed with a number from 1$$$1$$$ to 109$$$10^9$$$ (some cubes may be repeated).

Dunno experimented with various properties of pairs, but since he is currently studying the divisibility of numbers at school, he decided on the following rule: two adjacent cubes can be removed if the number on one cube is divisible by the number on the other cube (the order of the cubes in the pair is not important).

Unfortunately, with this formulation of the problem, a difficulty arises – not every line of cubes can be completely disassembled. Help Dunno – write a program that, given a preassembled line of cubes, will determine the minimum number of cubes that must be taken away so that the remaining cubes can be fully disassembled by removing pairs according to the rule used by Dunno.
input: The first line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤200$$$1 \le n \le 200$$$) – the number of cubes in the line. The second line contains n$$$n$$$ numbers separated by spaces – numbers written on cubes in a line if read from left to right.
output: The first line contains an integer k$$$k$$$ (0≤k≤n$$$0 \le k \le n$$$) – the number of cubes to be removed. If k>0$$$k  \gt  0$$$, then in the second line print the k$$$k$$$ integers ai$$$a_i$$$ (1≤ai≤n$$$1 \le a_i \le n$$$), separated by spaces – the numbers of the cubes to be removed. The cubes are numbered from left to right, the leftmost one has the number 1.
If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

legend.ai: 一天，Dunno 想出了一个新的立方体游戏——他将立方体从左到右排成一长列，然后移除具有某种性质的相邻立方体对。每移除一对立方体，右侧的立方体列就向左移动两个位置，以填补空缺。Dunno 恰好有 n$$$n$$$ 个立方体，每个立方体上都标有一个从 1$$$1$$$ 到 109$$$10^9$$$ 的数字(某些立方体上的数字可能重复)。
Dunno 尝试了成对立方体的各种性质，但由于他目前正在学校学习数字的整除性，因此决定采用如下规则：如果一个立方体上的数字能被另一个立方体上的数字整除，则可以移除这两个相邻立方体（这一对立方体的顺序无关紧要）。
不幸的是，按照这种问题表述，会出现一个困难——并非每一列立方体都能被完全拆解。请帮助 Dunno 编写一个程序：给定一列预先排列好的立方体，确定至少需要拿走多少个立方体，才能使剩余的立方体按照 Dunno 使用的规则通过移除成对立方体的方式被完全拆解。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤200$$$1 \le n \le 200$$$)——列中立方体的数量。第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个以空格分隔的数字——从左到右读取时，依次为列中立方体上写出的数字。

output.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 k$$$k$$$(0≤k≤n$$$0 \le k \le n$$$)——要移除的立方体数量。如果 k>0$$$k  \gt  0$$$，则在第二行输出 k$$$k$$$ 个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$(1≤ai≤n$$$1 \le a_i \le n$$$)，以空格分隔——要移除的立方体的编号。立方体从左到右编号，最左边的立方体编号为 1。
如果有多个解，输出其中任意一个即可。
